tooling.message:
fix(hooks): install an app's hooks only where the app is the root of its repository

## Intent

The template's prepare script installed the hook dispatcher into whichever git repo contains the folder. npm install in app-templates' quiz folder pointed the whole repo at the template's hooks, and commits at its root failed. Every generated app copied that script.

## Key changes

- `lernapps hooks` installs the hooks only where the current folder is the root of its git work tree, and otherwise says why it changed nothing.
- The generator writes it as every app's prepare script, so a template needs none of its own.
- The generator test covers both: an app at the root of its repo gets the hooks; the same app inside another repo leaves that repo's hooks alone.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The template drops its own prepare script (5267e05 in app-templates); merge this first.

app-templates.message:
fix(quiz): the template installs no git hooks

## Intent

npm install in quiz/ ran the template's prepare script, which set the hooks of the whole app-templates repo to the template's; commits at the root then failed.

## Key changes

- The quiz template has no prepare script; the generator writes the app's own.
- CI checks that npm install in a template leaves the repo's hooks alone.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs `lernapps hooks` from the tooling (00442ab, tooling#48).
